intro: Encroaching Gnolls is an Alliance task that alerts the town guard of Lakeshire to gnolls prowling dangerously close to the Elwynn border. Guard Parker discovers encampments clustering along the border pass, sending travelers ahead to warn Deputy Feldon. The news confirms Lakeshire's growing fears that the beastmen are threatening to cut off Redridge entirely.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hail, shaman. I am charged to patrol this stretch of road. Although the road is safe for now, I've seen gnoll encampments to the north and east of here.
Lakeshire must know of the gathering gnoll force! Report to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire and tell him of the gnolls. Do this, and I'm sure Feldon will offer you a scout's wage.
Feldon's usually inspecting the area south of the bridge to Lakeshire.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There are Redridge gnolls that close to Elwynn?? They may be poised to advance into our homeland. Soon the people of Lakeshire may not be the only travelers under siege!
Here is your pay, though you bring us dire news. And it comes at a bad time, for we are ill equipped to deal with it.
